name: Big two
summary: Cantonese shedding card game where players race to empty their 13-card hand by beating combinations.
rules_text: A standard 52-card deck is shuffled and dealt equally: 13 cards each for four players, 17 for three. 2 is highest rank, then A-K-Q-J-10-9-8-7-6-5-4-3. Suits break ties: Spades > Hearts > Clubs > Diamonds. The player with the lowest club or diamond starts by playing any single, pair, triple, or five-card poker hand (straight, flush, full house, four-of-a-kind+single, straight flush). Clockwise, each player must play the same type and same count but higher rank, or pass. If you pass you can re-enter later in same battle. When all others pass, the pile is cleared and the last player to play leads any combination. First to discard all cards wins the round. Scoring for gambling counts cards left in losers hands with doubles for many cards left, holding twos, or losing on twos or bombs.
